layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [CH ZKB Erweiterte Suche] (file name "Erweiterte Suche - Kontoauszug, Buchungen <yyyymmddhhmmss>.csv", one header row, Datum and Buchungstext first, Belastung as outflow and Gutschrift as inflow, %d.%m.%Y, semicolon)
notes: eBanking "Erweiterte Suche" export: one header row of 12 quoted names (Datum, Buchungstext, Whg, Betrag Detail, ZKB-Referenz, Referenznummer, Belastung CHF, Gutschrift CHF, Valuta, Saldo CHF, Zahlungszweck, Details), every field double-quoted, semicolons, dd.mm.yyyy, money out as a positive figure under Belastung and money in under Gutschrift, a dot decimal and no thousands mark, the balance after each line, newest first; Whg and Betrag Detail are only filled for collective orders and foreign currency. The full column list is from memory of user reports (bank2ynab only confirms the first six roles); UTF-8 with BOM and CRLF assumed. Opening = the oldest line's balance less its amount; closing = the newest line's balance.
